targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP(hour_bucket) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'hcmc' THEN total_orders ELSE 0 END) AS HCMC, SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'hanoi' THEN total_orders ELSE 0 END) AS Hanoi, SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'danang' THEN total_orders ELSE 0 END) AS Danang FROM food_delivery_dbt.rpt_hourly_revenue WHERE hour_bucket BETWEEN DATETIME(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)) AND DATETIME(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
